title: Run a shared request step
summary: Gin: Run a shared request step. Change the stored school name.
introduction: Middleware can set request values before calling the next handler. Open GET /school.
learningObjectives: Run a shared request step with Gin

blocks.text: Create a practice folder, run go mod init school and go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin@v1.10.0. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Run a shared request step

blocks.text: The middleware stores a context value, then calls Next. GetString reads it in the route.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Request context values belong to the current request.
